name: Battle
detailed_description:
B.A.T.T.L.E. is a high-action single-player FPS game with realistic shooting mechanics, stunning graphics, and intense combat. Step into the battlefield, master powerful weapons, and fight through challenging missions in a war-torn world.

Key Features:

🔫 64 Powerful Weapons – Use a wide range of guns, from rifles to snipers, each with unique handling.
🎨 240 Weapon Skins – Customize your guns with different skins to match your style.
🌍 Realistic Environments – Battle in detailed war zones with lifelike graphics and effects.
🧠 Smart AI Enemies – Fight against enemies that react and adapt to your tactics.
🎮 Smooth Gameplay – Optimized performance for high FPS and lag-free action.
🔥 Epic Story Mode – Experience a thrilling war story with action-packed missions.

Why Play B.A.T.T.L.E.?

  • Realistic Gunplay – True-to-life shooting mechanics with smooth controls.

  • High-Quality Graphics – Immersive visuals that bring the battlefield to life.

  • Full Weapon Customization – Unlock and equip skins to personalize your loadout.

  • Challenging Combat – Test your skills against advanced AI in intense battles.

If you love FPS games, action-packed shooting, and immersive war stories, B.A.T.T.L.E. is for you. Get ready to fight and become the ultimate warrior!

This game is still being actively improved. While it's fully playable, some features are being refined and bugs may exist. We're committed to regular updates based on your feedback. Thank you for your support!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6th Gen / Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD RX 580 8GB / GTX 1060 6GB
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9th Gen / Ryzen 7 3700X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1660 Super / RTX 2060 / RX 5600 XT
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes: B.A.T.T.L.E. contains realistic combat, blood effects, and intense firefights. Players engage in gunfights against enemies in war-torn environments. The game features violence, weapon-based combat, and explosions, but does not include excessive gore, torture, or dismemberment. There is no nudity, sexual content, or drug use in the game.
